description: The file defines an ACL (Access Control List) listener class for handling request events in a Symfony-based application. It implements security checks to enforce user access restrictions based on the requested URI.

classes.name: AclListener
classes.description: A Symfony event listener that intercepts request events to enforce access controls based on URI checks.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Event handler that checks if a request is authorized based on ACL rules. Throws an exception if access is denied.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping request events to the handler method.
